title: The Dye Book
blurb: Euphemia Lord won't cut for a stranger. Her grandmother's dye book went under with the family's dye house when the valley was drowned.

steps.title: The Dye Book
steps.objective: Comfort Lord's dye book went under with the Lords' dye house. Lower Harlow, Main Street, the blue door: a tin box on the sill. Don't open it.

steps.title: The Dye Book
steps.objective: Take the tin box back to Euphemia Lord, on Market Square.
